summary: TruBridge filed an 8-K announcing the expiration of the HSR Act waiting period for its pending merger with Inventurus Knowledge Solutions. Under the Merger Agreement dated April 23, 2026, Merger Sub will merge into TruBridge, making it a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. No price per share, premium, or deal value is specified. The merger requires approval by a majority of TruBridge's stockholders and other customary conditions. The HSR waiting period expired on June 22, 2026, clearing the antitrust hurdle. Key watch items: stockholder vote timing and any regulatory conditions. The risk-arb spread will depend on the disclosed consideration at announcement.
